definitions: People who help to make an action or process easier or smoother.
Individuals who guide a group discussion or process without taking a side, ensuring all participants can contribute.
In education, a person who helps students learn by providing resources and guidance rather than direct instruction.
examples: The workshop facilitators ensured everyone had a chance to speak.
Experienced facilitators are crucial for effective team building.
The project required several facilitators to manage the large group.
